newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. Vice President Gore arrives in Japan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Vice President Gore arrives in Japan.

text.p: U.S. Vice President Al Gore arrived in Tokyo on Sunday on the first leg of his eight-day Asian trip.
Gore was expected to meet Japanese Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda later in the day and hold talks with Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on Monday before leaving for China.
In talks with Ikeda and Hashimoto, Gore was expected to exchange views on the China policies of the two countries after the death of paramount Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping.
Japanese leaders were also expected to reassure Gore on Japan's continued commitment to keeping U.S. bases on Okinawa, the biggest domestic political problem.
In Beijing, Gore was expected to tackle thorny issues with Chinese leaders including allegations that China tried to illegally influence the outcome of last year's U.S. elections.
He flies to South Korea on Friday for negotiations on prospects of North Korea's participation in proposed peace talks on the Korean Peninsula.
